comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs (GS) and Citigroup (C) disclose activity related to assets and liabilities classified as 'held for sale'. GS specifically reports liabilities held for sale totaling $257 million as of December 2023 (primarily related to GreenSky), noting they were not material as of December 2024. Similarly, C reports selling or reclassifying corporate loans to held-for-sale status, amounting to $5.7 billion in 2023 and $5.2 billion in 2024. While GS focuses on the liability side of a specific business unit (GreenSky) becoming non-material, C reports a significant volume of corporate loans being moved to held-for-sale status over the same periods.
